title: Contract relationship record
description: Human-ratified Draft 2020-12 shape for ONE contract-relationship record: an authority endpoint and one-or-more dependent endpoints for a tracked contract. Validates a single record's shape and cardinality ONLY (exactly one authority, at least one dependent) — endpoints are bare stable-id strings; no graph-wide resolution, no cross-record uniqueness, no endpoint-existence checks (those belong to the Phase 25 compiler).

id.description: Stable record id for this relationship.

contract.description: Stable reference to the tracked contract this relationship is about.

authority.description: Exactly ONE authority endpoint (a bare stable-id string, not an array).
